prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one square, truly transparent website illustration of EXPLODING JULY FOURTH FIREWORKS, replacing a decorative rocket illustration in a collection of premium detailed hand-painted holiday collectibles. One large elegant radial firework bursting in the air with luminous red and ivory-white sparkling tips and gracefully arcing navy-blue and gold trails, accompanied by two smaller offset red/white/blue bursts. The visible subject is the explosion itself, not rockets, not launch tubes, not a pinwheel. Delicate rich hand-painted brush and ink textures, dimensional warm metallic highlights, crisp intricate contours, sophisticated storybook illustration matching ornate wicker picnic baskets with satin red bows, natural bald eagles, and red-white-navy pinwheels. The bursts form ONE compact balanced vignette. Include clearly visible radial trails and starry sparks but keep every trail and spark well within the canvas with at least 12% transparent padding. Actual transparent background and all gaps between trails, no black sky, smoke cloud, opaque glow rectangle, ground, text, labels, frame or watermark. Detailed artwork readable over a dark navy website. Rich red and navy with ivory-white and restrained gold details. Not cartoony, no faces.
